recent.text: On November 25, 2023, the @LAKings shutout the Montreal Canadiens on home ice for the first time in franchise history. Pheonix Copley made 18 saves, and Trevor Moore scored two goals in a 4-0 win for the #LAKings. #GoKingsGo https://t.co/fH2tF1t2jt
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 25, 2018, Dustin Brown recorded his fifth career hat trick in a 5-2 win over the Edmonton Oilers. Rookie @LAKings goaltender Cal Petersen made 32 saves and recorded his first home win at STAPLES Center. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/tnZgeyKJj9
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 25, 1993, Luc Robitaille matched an NHL record, and established a new @LAKings' franchise record when he scored four power play goals in an 8-6 loss against the Quebec Nordiques on Thanksgiving Day. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/RREQIU5ezL
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 25, 1988, the @LAKings acquired left wing Gilles Hamel from the Winnipeg Jets for Paul Fenton. Hamel had one assist in 11 games with the #LAKings. #GoKingsGo https://t.co/X9cBgtu87O
